Dear HeliumDeploy Support Team,

I hope this email finds you well.

I would like to confirm whether your advertised 48% discount on the bundle
containing the following three nodes is still available:

1. Bemeable Node
2. Nubila Cloudy Node
3. Warp Node

Could you please confirm whether this promotional offer is currently active and
whether I am authorized to continue promoting the bundle through my website,
KingdomAffiliateOffers, and my social media channels using my affiliate link?

I would also appreciate it if you could let me know the promotion's validity
period, if applicable, and whether there are any specific terms or guidelines I
should follow when advertising this offer.

I look forward to your response.

Warm regards,
Aremo M.
KingdomAffiliateOffers

--

Hi Adeoye,

Thanks for checking before you promote it, that's the right way round.

I can't confirm the 48% bundle from my side. None of the three nodes, Bemeable, Nubila Cloudy or Warp, come up in our live product data as a bundle, so I don't want to give you a price, an end date or a green light that turns out to be wrong once it's on your site and your social channels.

Affiliate campaigns and the terms around how offers can be advertised sit with Georges, and I've passed your question to him with the three nodes you named and your affiliate link. He'll come back to you in this thread with whether the offer is live, how long it runs, and the guidelines for promoting it. The team is offline over the weekend and picks this up Monday at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email.

In the meantime I'd hold off publishing the 48% figure until he confirms it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

This is a kind reminder.

Thanks

--

Sent with Hostinger Mail [https://mail.hostinger.com/]

Hi Adeoye,

Thanks for the nudge, and sorry you've been waiting on this.

Your question is with Georges, who handles affiliate campaigns and the rules on how our offers can be advertised. He picks it up today from 10am ET and will reply here with whether the 48% bundle is live, how long it runs, and the guidelines for promoting it.

Nothing has changed on my side since my last note: the three nodes don't come up as a bundle in our live product data, so I'd still hold off publishing the 48% figure until he confirms it in writing. If anything else in your affiliate setup needs checking at the same time, send it in this thread and he'll pick it all up together.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
